notes: CLOSED 2026-08-30 by a native, axiom-free kernel construction, finishing what `log-clog-finish` (docs/plan/status/337-log-clog-finish.md) left open. `clogAux`'s two guard cuts play SWAPPED roles from `logAux`'s: the outer cut `2 <= base` is a pure base cut, individually known true from the statement's own `1 < a`/`1 < b` hypotheses (no case split, unlike log's outer `b <= n`); the inner cut `2 <= n` is the SAME expression on both sides (the value is fixed), needing exactly one case split (unlike log's two). The hard part was the recursive step: it compares two different CEILING quotients `(n+b-1)/b` and `(n+a-1)/a` at different bases, which `Nat.div_le_div_left` does not cover directly (that lemma shares one numerator). The bridge is a new private identity `Eq (sub (add n base) 1) (add (sub n 1) base)`, valid only given `Le 1 n` (`Nat.sub` truncates -- at `n = 0` the two sides differ), proved by reconstructing `n` as `succ (pred n)` (`succ_pred_of_pos`) and cancelling the `succ` against the literal `1` on both sides via `succ_add`/`succ_sub_succ`/`sub_zero`. Composed with the existing `Nat.add_div_right`, this rewrites each side's ceiling quotient to `(n-1)/base + 1`, turning the comparison into a floor comparison at the shared numerator `n-1` (`Nat.div_le_div_left` plus `add_le_add_right`). From there the composition is the same as `log_aux_antitone_base`'s: `IH` at the SAME bases with the b-side's quotient, chained through `clog_aux_mono` at the fixed base `a`, `le_trans`, then `le_succ_succ`. `crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/nat_prelude/log_clog_order.rs` (new `Nat.clog_aux_antitone_base`, `Nat.clog_antitone_left`, plus private helpers `one_le_of_two_le`, `add_sub_one_swap`, `ceil_div_succ_of_pos`). The external Mathlib theorem remains prior art; its proof term and tactic trace were not consulted. formal.statement remains the pinned Lean surface spelling, definitionally equivalent to the explicit core rendering checked by the evidence command.
